radius.doc: Blur radius as a fraction of the canvas short edge (evaluated, then rounded to whole pixels; the implementation separately has a 256 px structural cap)

doc: Single-pass separable box blur, integer truncating division, operating on premultiplied sRGB. Edges shrink the window (smaller divisor) instead of padding with zeros. The radius is converted to pixels against the canvas short edge and rounded to an integer; the implementation separately has a 256 px cap that only guards against pathological values; the sliding window itself is O(1) per pixel. The CPU reference uses the non-zero content bounding-box version, which is byte-identical to the full-frame version (covered by an equivalence test).
